[Verse 1]
I bought the paint on Saturday

The colour under the colour there

[Chorus]

The brightest room I've ever seen

A wall does not remember why
Two coats of white to wipe it clean
The brightest room I've ever seen

[Bridge]

I picked the white for her today

Under the colour, far away
